name: Abdul Matin
contribution: Abdul Matin, widely known as Bhasha Matin, was a student organiser and communist activist in the Bengali Language Movement.
context: He helped lead the Dhaka University Language Action Committee and pressed for direct mobilisation when the state refused equal recognition for Bengali.
impact: His organising turned language rights from a constitutional demand into disciplined mass action.
